meta.name: browser-cdp
meta.description: Use this skill when you need to control a Chrome browser via CDP (Chrome DevTools Protocol) to reuse existing login sessions. Covers: launching Chrome in debug mode, opening URLs, waiting for page load, evaluating JavaScript, taking snapshots, and extracting auth tokens. Trigger phrases: browser automation, CDP, agent-browser, 浏览器操作, 操作浏览器, Chrome CDP, 复用登录态, extract token from browser.

copy.tagline: 让脚本自动操作浏览器并复用现有登录状态
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你有一份已登录的浏览器会话,想通过脚本操作页面或取走登录凭证
copy.tagline_en: Control a browser with scripts and reuse an existing signed-in session
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a logged-in browser and want to script it or grab the auth token.

howto.what: 让 Claude 通过 CDP 控制 Chrome,复用你已有的登录态,完成打开网页、等待加载、执行 JavaScript、取快照、提取 token 等操作。首次启动前会先探测状态,需要重启 Chrome 时会先征求你同意。
howto.when: 当你提到 browser automation、CDP、复用登录态 等关键词,或要求操作浏览器、从浏览器里提取 token 时触发。若已有 Chrome 在运行,它会先问你是否允许重启。

say.text: 用 CDP 打开 https://example.com 并等页面加载完
say.note: 经 9222 调试实例打开并等待

say.text: 在页面上跑 JS,把 localStorage 里的 token 取出来
say.note: 返回 eval 的执行结果

say.text: 给当前页面做快照,列出可交互的元素
say.note: 返回元素引用供后续点击

howto.what_en: Claude drives Chrome over CDP and reuses your existing login sessions: open URLs, wait for load, run JavaScript, take snapshots, extract auth tokens. It detects CDP status first, and asks you before killing your running Chrome.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention browser automation, CDP, reusing login sessions, etc., or ask to operate a browser or pull a token out of it. If Chrome is already running, it asks first.

say_en.text: Use CDP to open https://example.com and wait for it to load
say_en.note: Opens via the debug instance on port 9222

say_en.text: Run JS on the page to read the token from localStorage
Take a snapshot and list the interactive elements
say_en.note: Returns element refs to click later
